text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's entry into the Satsuki 
Sho. "You said you didn't have a goal!" 
Tosen Jordan shouted in fury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her peers ascend to their dream 
stage is blinding... Due to her injury, 
Tosen Jordan's hopes of making an impact 
in the Classic races had become hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The 'Classic Triple Crown path,' where 
everyone puts their life on the line. 
Nakayama Festa was no different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To bring hope to her former teacher, she 
couldn't afford an unsightly defeat. —Now, 
let's place our bets.
